text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Mejiro Dober's debut race has 
finally arrived! Just as we were about to 
leave the inn early for Niigata 
Racecourse—
Oh, there you are~. Dober~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright!? What are you doing here—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To cheer for her, of course~ How could I 
not be here to witness the debut of my 
fellow comrade, Dober~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Coming all this way for me... Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's too early to thank me, you 
know~? Because I'm not the only one who 
came to cheer you on~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, do your best today! Just relax 
your shoulders and run, you'll be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro Ryan. A fellow Mejiro Umamusume, 
and a predecessor who wove the Mejiro 
family's glory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They've known each other since childhood, 
and I hear they're as close as sisters to 
Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Give everything you've built up to this 
day. ...I'm expecting great things from 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Air Groove. Hailed as the "Empress," she 
possesses both the talent of a 
mother-daughter duo who conquered the 
Oaks, and the trust earned as the Student 
Council Vice President.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Known for her caring nature, she often 
looked after Mejiro Dober before Dober met 
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan...! Even Air Groove-senpai is 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Doing all this for someone 
like me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No way, don't say 'someone like me'! We 
all came here because we wanted to see you 
run, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dober cheered for me in my debut race 
before, after all. ...Allow me to be there 
to witness hers this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... so much...! I'll run all the 
way to the end, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bolstered by the warm cheering, a fierce 
light ignited in Mejiro Dober's eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up. Of course I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. To be honest, even my hands are 
trembling...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I definitely want to run all the 
way to the finish line...! For the sake of 
everyone watching...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, honestly, you always... have to go 
and say things like that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Trainer, you really are always so 
direct at times like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Then keep your eyes on me. Watch me... 
run all the way to the end.
